title: Instance information
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Version and uptime are informational; no automatic configuration assessment is made.

title: Database inventory
permissions: Visibility of the queried metadata; results may be partial.
notes: Recovery model, owner and compatibility require context; they are not automatically classified as good or bad.

title: Database files and growth settings
permissions: Visibility of the queried metadata; results may be partial.
notes: Shows allocated size, not actual space used; FILESTREAM requires separate measurement.

title: Service status
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER SECURITY STATE (2022+).
notes: Output includes service accounts and paths from the queried server.

title: Blocked sessions and their blockers
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Includes blockers without an active request. Negative IDs have special meanings and do not represent ordinary logins.

title: Active requests
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: SQL text is optional and may contain personal data or secrets. Percent complete is available only for certain operations.

title: Resources by session
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Counters accumulate over the session; memory_usage describes session memory, not total query memory.

title: Locks in the selected database
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Preserves resource IDs without assuming every lock represents a HoBT. Negative session IDs are preserved.

title: Recorded suspect pages
permissions: SELECT on the queried msdb tables; request specific access from your DBA.
notes: An empty result does not prove database integrity; no DBCC command or repair is performed.

title: tempdb data file usage
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: The connection must use tempdb. Reserved space is not equivalent to bytes used by records.

title: Cumulative file I/O
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Counters are cumulative, not sampled over an interval. Averages do not describe the latency distribution.

title: Scheduler queues
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Snapshot of visible online schedulers; review multiple samples before concluding that they are saturated.

title: Cached procedure statistics
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: One row per cached plan. Restarts, recompilation and cache eviction change the counter window.

title: Cached trigger statistics
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Does not inventory triggers absent from the cache; no trigger is executed.

title: Cached queries by CPU usage
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Counters describe cached plans, not permanent history. SQL text may contain sensitive values and is opt-in.

title: Cached queries by logical reads
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Counters describe cached plans, not permanent history. SQL text may contain sensitive values and is opt-in.

title: Memory configuration and status
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Does not calculate an ideal value or reconfigure the instance. Some memory consumers are outside the max server memory limit.

title: Cumulative instance wait statistics
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Does not clear counters or exclude categories heuristically. Background waits may dominate the ranking.

title: Disk-based table space
permissions: VIEW DATABASE STATE and VIEW DEFINITION (2016–2019); VIEW DATABASE PERFORMANCE STATE and VIEW SECURITY DEFINITION (2022+).
notes: Approximate rows are counted only for heaps and clustered indexes; space includes indexes. Excludes memory-optimized table memory and external FILESTREAM files.

title: Index and data space inventory
permissions: Visibility of the queried metadata; results may be partial.
notes: A data space can be a filegroup or partition scheme; the query does not associate every file in a filegroup with an index.

title: Index usage counters
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: NULL means there is no DMV record, not that an index is unnecessary. Counters can reset and do not measure modified rows.

title: Missing index estimates
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Optimizer suggestions are incomplete and do not justify creating indexes automatically; no DDL is generated.

title: Statistics properties
permissions: Permission to query object metadata and statistics; see the reference.
notes: NULL may indicate a missing statistics blob or insufficient visibility; age alone does not determine whether an update is needed.

title: Latest backups by type
permissions: SELECT on the queried msdb tables; request specific access from your DBA.
notes: Local history may have been removed or may exist on another replica. Does not prove recoverability or log chain coverage.

title: Database replica status
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE (2022+).
notes: Visibility on a secondary replica is mainly local; an empty result does not prove health. Queue sizes are in KB and rates in KB/s.

title: Direct sysadmin members
permissions: Visibility of server principals and role memberships; see the reference.
notes: Does not expand Windows group membership or resolve each identity's effective permissions.

title: Explicit database permissions
permissions: Visibility of the queried metadata; results may be partial.
notes: Does not calculate effective permissions or role inheritance. Securable IDs are preserved for every class.

title: Potential orphaned SQL users
permissions: Full visibility of SQL Server logins and database users.
notes: Includes only INSTANCE authentication, not contained users. Partial login visibility may cause false positives.

title: Database encryption status
permissions: VIEW SERVER STATE (2016–2019); VIEW SERVER SECURITY STATE (2022+).
notes: Missing DMV keys are shown explicitly; does not export keys, password hashes or certificates.

title: Job status and latest completion
permissions: SELECT on the queried msdb tables; request specific access from your DBA.
notes: Activity comes from the most recent Agent session; it does not prove that the service is currently running.

title: Job completion history
permissions: SELECT on the queried msdb tables; request specific access from your DBA.
notes: Duration is calculated numerically, including runs longer than 24 hours. Dates use local times recorded by Agent; error messages are not included.

title: Pagination with deterministic ordering
permissions: Database connection; uses synthetic values only.
notes: A tie-breaker avoids ambiguous ordering. Concurrent production data requires its own consistency strategy.

title: Distribution and percentile ranking
permissions: Database connection; uses synthetic values only.
notes: PERCENT_RANK and CUME_DIST handle ties differently; no permanent table is created.

title: NULL predicates
permissions: Database connection; uses synthetic values only.
notes: Uses IS NULL and IS NOT NULL; does not disable ANSI_NULLS or require a sample database table.
